title: First jobs in Louisville pleasure houses and meeting Tony Jackson
summary: Solo piano in Louisville houses and clubs; he and Tony Jackson were the two pianists at the Cosmopolitan Club in 1904.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Where did you play? What were the first jobs you had?
Well, the first jobs I had was Lulee's, Tom Cole's, Jimmy Boyd at Tenth and Walnut. And then I played around all the houses, the pleasure houses.
Did they just use a piano? They didn't have a band? No, just a piano. Just a piano?
Just a piano around all the pleasure houses. And then two piano players at the Cosmopolitan Club, Tony Jackson and myself in Louisville.
That's where you first met Tony?
Yes. And he was a big hit there because he could sing good, you know.
About what year was that? How old were you? Do you remember?
